snippet.title: Montabi | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist/check out the demo on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141630/Montabi/?utm_source=agyoutube

The announcement trailer that gives a whole new meaning to rap battles...

@Montabi, the new creature collector roguelike deckbuilder from the lovely people at @mankibogames, drops on August 6! 

Get it on your wishlist so you don't miss out and check out the demo while you're waiting!

To learn more about 
Mankibo and Akupara Games, visit:  
►Mankibo: https://mankibo.com/
►Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
